internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service Elevated Error Rate Due to Dependency Unreachable
internal.body:
At 10:59 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for the cart service due to a high error rate. Investigation revealed that the cart service was experiencing errors caused by an inability to reach a critical dependency, identified as the Valkey service. This was confirmed by error logs and trace spans showing 'Valkey connection error'.

The diagnosis was completed by 11:19 UTC, and a mitigation action was taken by disabling the 'cartFailure' flag. This action was approved and executed promptly, resulting in recovery as verified by a significant drop in error rates.

No evidence was found supporting error injection or a bad deployment as causes. The root cause was confirmed as a dependency unreachable issue.

Timeline:
- 10:59 UTC: Alert received
- 11:19 UTC: Diagnosis confirmed dependency unreachable
- 11:19 UTC: Mitigation action executed
- 11:19 UTC: Recovery verified

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.

external.body: Between 10:59 and 11:19 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced issues adding items to their shopping carts due to a temporary service disruption. The issue was caused by a connectivity problem with a dependent service. Our team identified and resolved the problem promptly, and normal service was restored. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
